title: アドバンスト環境化学
subtitle: Advanced Environmental Chemistry
keywords: Securing of aquatic resources 2.Water clean-up systems 3.Water clean-up materials 4.Methods and apparatus for analyzing water quality 5.Aquatic environment preservation
educationalGoal: You will learn about modern environmental problems based on the chemical knowledge acquired previously in the lectures. The goal of this course is to acquire the ability to understand local environmental problems and work toward solutions by examining methods for securing of aquatic resources, water purification materials, quality of water analyses, and others. You will have a basic understanding of these specialized subjects in environmental chemistry.
advice: 1. Understand how to securing aquatic resources and maintain water quality of the water supply and sewer system. 2. Understand water clean-up systems based on materials chemistry, analytical chemistry, and environmental chemistry. 3. Understand water clean-up materials using inorganic materials, such as zeolites and organic-inorganic hybrid materials. 4. Can use methods and apparatus to analyze water quality and secure water resources. 5. Understand water quality conservation methods and techniques for determining water quality. 6. Understand the utilization of carbon resources and the carbon cycle.
requiredKnowledge: A knowledge of chemistry and biology gained from high school courses is needed to understand the lectures.

activityGoals.body: Explain maintaining water quality of the water supply and sewer.
Explain the development of water clean-up materials.
Understand water quality measurements needed to secure water resources.
Explain water quality conservation methods and techniques for determining water quality.
Explain utilization of carbon resources and the carbon cycle.

achievementLevels.ideal: Able to explain the following issues: 1. Securing water and sewage and maintaining water quality in the present system. 2. The entire water clean-up system. 3. The development of water purification materials, such as zeolites, including chemical reactions. 4. Water quality measurement and water quality analysis equipment. 5. Practical water quality conservation methods. 6. The utilization of carbon resources in relation to environmental issues.
achievementLevels.standard: Able to understand the following issues using references to textbooks, reference books, and dictionaries: 1. The method for maintaining the water quality. 2. The development of water purification materials. 3. Water quality measurements for securing water resources. 4. The utilization of carbon resources in relation to environmental issues.
